instruction: A candid cinematic medium shot inside a restaurant decorated with hanging plants and warm lights. On the left, the man with dreadlocks in the dark suit (R2) stands in profile facing right, smiling. On the right, the bearded man in the black suit (R1) stands facing left, smiling warmly. They shake right hands in the center, while the bearded man (R1) holds a small black folder in his left hand. The background is softly blurred with warm pendant lights and natural light coming from a window on the right.
